item.title: What to watch Tuesday: Primaries in Wisconsin and Minnesota showcase Democratic divide
item.description: The Democratic Party’s ideological divide is moving into new territory. In Tuesday’s election, the main contest is in swing state Wisconsin where democratic socialist Francesca Hong wants to become her party’s nominee for governor.
